english.title: Fail to arrange display of temporary use notice - Gambling Act 2005
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having given a temporary use notice in respect of **(..SPECIFY PREMISES..), failed without reasonable excuse to arrange for a copy of the notice to be displayed prominently on the premises at a time when an activity was being carried on in reliance on that notice
english.legislation: Contrary to section 229(1)(a), (2) and (3) of the Gambling Act 2005.
